offering_description.value: ITT designs and manufactures flow and process equipment, friction and damping components, and electrical and fiber-optic interconnects for industrial operators, vehicle manufacturers, and aerospace and defense customers. It supplies equipment and components for new systems and provides replacement parts, repair, and field service for installed equipment.

primary_products.value: Industrial pumps and valves; mixers and other process equipment; brake pads and friction materials; electrical and fiber-optic connectors and cable assemblies; shock absorbers and vibration dampers

primary_services.value: Pump and process equipment repair and overhaul; field maintenance; equipment installation and commissioning; shipboard cable installation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Process plant operators, industrial engineering contractors, automotive and rail manufacturers, and aerospace and defense contractors; B2G: Military agencies and naval fleet operators

end_markets.value: Energy and chemical processing; food and beverage processing; automotive and rail; aerospace and defense; general industrial manufacturing

revenue_model.value: product sales: Original equipment, production components, and aftermarket replacement parts; service fees: Equipment repair, overhaul, and field maintenance; project or contract: Engineered process systems and cable installation projects
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns metals and purchased components into pumps and process equipment for plant operators and engineering contractors; component supplier: Uses friction materials, metals, and electrical and optical parts to build components for vehicle, rail, and aerospace manufacturers; service provider: Repairs installed equipment for plant operators and installs cable assemblies for naval customers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; component supplier; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa

specialization.value: diversified: Flow and process equipment, vehicle braking and damping components, and interconnect systems serve distinct customer groups

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving plant operators, engineering contractors, vehicle manufacturers, and aerospace and defense customers; distributors / dealers: Independent industrial equipment, replacement parts, and electronic component distributors; own locations: Company-operated service centers for pump and process equipment repair and overhaul
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; own locations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Manufacturing faces environmental and workplace safety rules, and certain defense products are subject to U.S. export controls.

notes: The relative scale of the current product lines is approximate.
